name: Che chuoi
summary: Chè chuối is the banana sweet the 19 Jun 2019 roundup and the 4 Oct 2024 Con Market page name on the outdoor counters. They do not describe the bowl. Chè, the wider sweet-soup name, is a separate line.
origin: Named at Con Market’s outdoor row. A recipe was not printed.
howToEat: The market pages name chè chuối and do not describe a method. Check on arrival.
where: Outdoor counters at Con Market. The 2019 roundup says to use that row after 15:00. The 2024 page does not restate the split.
seoTitle: Che chuoi — banana sweet at Con Market
seoDescription: Con Market’s outdoor counters name chè chuối. The city pages do not describe the bowl. The hour split at 15:00 is only on the 2019 page. Check on arrival.
